entries.text: If we’re lucky, there’ll be another herb here...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: I knew it![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: It really is here! This is one of the herbs, make\nno mistake![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Woo-hoo! We did it!\nThanks, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_05
entries.text: Now then, let’s see... What does the book have\nto say?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_a
entries.text:
It says here that the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sweet Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is good
for gut health and that it helps aid digestion.\c
Says it’s great for stomachaches, too, or when
you want to stimulate the ol’ appetite![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_b
entries.text:
Well, apparently [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Salty Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] helps with
aching hands and feet. Good for neuropathy and
numbness.\c
When you’ve got muscle weakness, it supposedly
builds up strength again![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_c
entries.text:
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Bitter Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]’s great for your circulation!
It really gets the blood flowing!\c
And that warms you right up, nice and toasty,
even boosting the immune system!\c
...Or so it says.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_d
entries.text:
OK, [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sour Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is chock-full of nutrients
and is great for boosting your overall health!\c
Says here it works wonders whether you’re tired
physically or mentally. Perks you right up![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_e
entries.text:
So it seems [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Spicy Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]’s supposed to
boost your metabolism!\c
It gives your circulation a boost and helps flush
out all those toxins...along with a ton of sweat![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_06
entries.text: If I can just slip this into a tasty sandwich and get\nhim to eat some...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_07
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well, what are we waiting for,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
It’s
time
to
dig in!\c
Let me whip something up for us![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: Yeeeaaarrrt! Hiya! Huwatcha![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_08
entries.text: ...And Bob’s your uncle!\c\nHere you go! My special, whimsical, herb-filled\nsuper sandwich![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: And it comes with a side of...Titan Badge!\nAs a token of my gratitude, ’course![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: Hmph. Is it trying to say thanks or something?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: Well, good thing I made extra.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: You’re helping me out a whole bunch with the\nhard stuff, so it’s only fair that you get more.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: I definitely, absolutely did not make extra so that\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)] could have a sandwich, OK?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: Man, these Herba Mystica really do pack a\npunch, don’t they?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_17
entries.text: I mean...they’d better. Or else I’m really up\nthe creek.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_20
entries.text: Oh, uh...sorry. I shouldn’t have shouted like that...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_21
entries.text: I guess I should at least tell you the full story,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_22
entries.text: Come on out, bud...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_23
entries.text: This is Mabosstiff. My partner.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_legend_11
entries.text: Ah gia?

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_24
entries.text: Here you go, bud. Eat up. This sandwich should\nhelp you feel better.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_25
entries.text: Slowly now. Take your time.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_26
entries.text: Small bites are fine. Just chew nice and slow...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_27
entries.text: My buddy here was...hurt pretty bad a while ago.\nReal bad, in fact.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_28
entries.text: He never really recovered.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_select_03
entries.text: Potions and things don’t work?

entries.label: legend_0030_select_04
entries.text: Have you tried a Pokémon Center?

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29a
entries.text: Nothing seems to help. Not Potions, not\nPokémon Centers... Nothing.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29b
entries.text: They said this wasn’t any regular old injury\nor illness...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_30
entries.text: Mabosstiff here is the only thing in the world I\ncare about. The only thing...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_31
entries.text: So, I promised that I’d make him better—\nwhatever it takes.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_32
entries.text: I searched online, I read books, I looked all over\nand tried every cure and remedy I could find.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_33
entries.text: But nothing really worked. I’d almost given\nup hope...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_34
entries.text: That’s when I found out about the Herba Mystica![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_select_05
entries.text: That book—what is it?

entries.label: legend_0030_select_06
entries.text: You’ve done your research!

entries.text: I found it in my mom’s lab.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_35b
entries.text: I found it in my dad’s lab.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_36a
entries.text: Yeah. See, I found this book in my mom’s lab...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_37b
entries.text: Yeah. See, I found this book in my dad’s lab...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_38
entries.text: It’s this book full of crazy stories and legends\nand things—stuff nobody’d usually believe.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_39
entries.text: But I believe it! I think what it says is true![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_40
entries.text: And according to this book, eating all five Herba\nMystica can cure anything that ails you![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_41
entries.text: Case in point, Mabosstiff’s paws were cold as ice\nbefore he ate that last herb. But they’ve warmed\r\nup a little now—I’m sure they have![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_42
entries.text: Oh! You done eating, bud?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_43
entries.text: H-hey! Mabosstiff! Can...can you see? Are your\neyes open?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_44
entries.text: Yes! I did it![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_45
entries.text: It...it’s been so long since he was able to open his\neyes! I was so worried...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_46
entries.text: *sniff*\nOh man, I—! I’m so—! I’m so glad![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: *whine*

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_47
entries.text:
*sniffle*
Heh... Ehehehehe... Aw, look at him.\c
Those fiery orange little eyes... Hard to even tell
if they’re open or not, but I know the difference![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_48
entries.text: The power of these herbs is amazing! I knew the\nbook wasn’t lying![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_49
entries.text: I’m gonna bring Mabosstiff back to full health,\nI swear it![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: legend_0030_friend_50
entries.text: Oh...uh, yeah. So, that’s my story.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
